item.title: Stretch, Resistance & Light Cardio — Wed Oct 14, 9:30 AM — Montclair Public Library
item.description:
According to medical professionals, it is important to keep the body flexible & the bones strong. The synovial fluid in our joints is extremely important for good movement. Strong muscles act like shock absorbers to protect our bones. With resistance exercises, the bones and muscles will remain strong or even become stronger. Please bring a yoga mat to class, it is required. Light hand & leg weights optional.
Source: Libcal Bccls 10306

item.title: MWC Presents: Anjali Dalal, Founder of Salonette — Fri Oct 16, 1:30 PM — Montclair Women’s Club
item.description:
Anjali Dalal, is a Montclair resident and founder of Salonette, the small, off-the-record living room discussions where friends and neighbors gather to talk through issues impacting their community. They are so much more and they are spreading across NJ. Come learn how Salonette started in Montclair, what it involves, and how they grow. Their mission is hopeful and could not be more important- to increase local civic engagement, deepen social connection and improve how we discuss politics. Join the excitement! item.title: Montclair Film Festival Opening Night - Wild Horse Nine — Fri Oct 16, 7:00 PM — The Wellmont Theater
item.description:
Shortly before the 1973 Chilean coup, CIA agents Chris (John Malkovich) and Lee (Sam Rockwell) are dispatched from Santiago to Easter Island by their bureau chief, MJ (Steve Buscemi). Amongst the Island’s iconic statues, and as the longtime partners wrestle with their dark pasts and present conspiracies, Chris’s newfound bond with a pair of rebellious students (Mariana di Girolamo and Ailín Salas) threatens to send everyone’s trip to this remote paradise sideways. Driven by outstanding performances and a powerful story, WILD HORSE NINE marks Martin McDonagh’s triumphant return to the screen. item.title: Inner Body Meditation (20 minutes) — Thu Oct 22, 9:30 PM
item.description:
The Mindful Stream "Awareness of the inner body takes you beyond the mind." - Eckhart Tolle
In this mediation session we will bring our attention here: to the inner body. Sessions are suitable for newcomers, those experienced in Tolle's teachings and anyone wishing to remain completely anonymous. They will last around 20 minutes and cameras and microphones will be disabled. (Depending on the situation, a free discussion may be held at the end with mics and cameras allowed.)
See you there!
Please be aware that sessions will close if no members have joined after 10 minutes.
Emrys also organises a free Work of Byron Katie online mediation group. Visit [this Meetup Group link](https://www.meetup.com/thework-runsfree/) for more information.21

item.title: Reeds, Rhythm and All That Brass — Sun Nov 1, 2:00 PM — West Orange - Community Room 1
item.description:
An Afternoon of Big Band Music
Don't miss this glorious tribute to the big band era of the 1930s and 1940s. Featuring the music America danced and swung to during World War II, this era was one of the most musically influential periods in music history. RRB's performance offers a nostalgic journey, recalling the times when Americans danced in music halls across the country to the greatest bandleaders in history.
About the presenters
The legendary 17-piece big band known as Reeds, Rhythm, and All That Brass (RRB) plays the greatest swing-pop standards by greats including Basie, Ellington, Goodman, Sinatra, and Darin.
Frank Sole, Henry Nerenberg, Jay Wilensky, Darrell Courtley, and Jeff Rantzer are the regulars in the band.
Source: Libcal Bccls 10341
